messages:
Alex: FYI - getting multiple customer reports that pages didn't go out starting ~09:03 UTC. Alerts visible in console but no oncall pages :rotating_light:
Maria: I'm seeing 400s from pd-integration at the webhook-proxy layer, looks like header rejection during delivery.
Jordan: I never received any pages. I only saw the slack alerts.
incidentbot: delivery_error: pd-integration webhook rejected - missing required header "X-PD-Routing" (downstream 400)
Ryan: Reproduced locally against staging proxy. Proxy config is stripping unknown headers after the nginx rewrite change yesterday. Quick repro:
```
curl -v -H "X-PD-Routing: oncall" -X POST https://proxy.redwood.internal/pd-webhook -d '{"evt":"test"}'
> HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
< {"error":"missing header X-PD-Routing"}
```
Sophie: Manual pages sent via PD UI for impacted customers, we've had 3 support tickets so far. Escalation in progress.
Maria: Rolling back the header-strip rule to previous behavior now (nginx map -> keep unrecognized headers). Patch queued to canary 09:18.
Alex: If rollback succeeds we should retry queued deliveries. Also need to know how many events got dropped vs queued.
pagerduty-bot: retry_summary: 23 queued events from 09:03-09:12. On retry after 09:20: 21 succeeded, 2 failed -> manual follow-up required.
Ryan: Patch applied to canary and then prod at 09:19. Confirmed proxies now forward "X-PD-Routing" header.
Maria: Triggering incidentbot retry endpoint: `POST /internal/incidentbot/retry?since=1736540180` -> started.
incidentbot: retry_log: started 23 events -> 21 delivered (200), 2 returned 502 from third-party sms gateway. Those 2 belong to customers already contacted via manual escalation.
Jordan: Confirmed oncall got pages for the retries. No new pages missed after 09:20. Monitoring: elevated but stable.
Sophie: Filed support follow-ups for the two failed deliveries, reached out to affected customers.
Alex: Immediate mitigation = rollback proxy header strip + manual retries. Next actions: postmortem, alert for header-strip rules on proxy config changes, add unit test to integration that rejects header-stripping.
Sophie: I'll open the incident ticket and assign postmortem owners.
Ryan: Also adding a quick smoke test in deploy pipeline: `curl` webhook with required headers and assert 200.
Maria: Note for follow-up: check why incidentbot didn't surface the delivery failures earlier; add a metric for webhook 4xx/5xx ratio > 1% to page #eng-sre.
Alex: Thanks all. No further customer impact reported as of 09:35 UTC. :thumbsup:
Sophie: creating retro doc now -> /docs/incidents/1736543210-retro (will link in ticket).
Jordan: marking as monitoring, will update if anything else pops up.
